s: Din shittupe haddirot leerub ubo k"b seipim: lo aseru letaltel mereshut hayyachid shel zeh lirshut hayyachid shel zeh beli erub ella bebattim shettashmishan meyuchad vetadir. Abal haggaggot shehen semukin zeh lezeh beli hepseq reshut harabbim benehem, veken hachatzerot hassemukot veken haqqarpepot, veken kol kayyotze bahem mehammeqomot sheen tashmishan meyuchad vetadir — kullan reshut achat hen lekelim sheshshabetu betokam, shemmuttar letaltel mimmaqom zeh sheen tashmisho tadir lemaqom acher sheen tashmisho tadir apillu hem shel bealim harbeh velo erebu yachad, ubilbad shello yetaltel mittokam labbayit beli erub im hem shel bealim mechullaqim, lepi shehabbayit chaluq mehem veeno reshut achat immahem, veken mehabbayit letokam. Ketzad? Metaltel hu mechatzer zo lechatzer acheret ap al pi shello erebu yachad, vaapillu im gam kol achat veachat bipne atzmah gam ken lo ereba. O mechatzer zo legag shel bayit acher sheeno bechatzer zo velo erebu yachad, vehu sheyyetaltel al haggag mammash milmala, abal al tiqrat habbayit tachat gag haelyon — dino kishar chadarim. O mechatzer lerosh hakkotel shebben shette chatzerot, sherosh kotel zeh dino kegag. O mechatzer shel zeh leqarpep shel acher, vehu sheeno yoter mibbet satayim, o shehuqqap ledira apillu hu yoter mibbet satayim. O mechatzer lemaboy hammetuqqan belechi o qora, ap al pi shello nishtattepu bo, sheddino gam ken kechatzer sheenah meorebet velo kekarmelit, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shp"ch. Veken metaltel miggag zeh legag shel acher hassamuk lo, apillu gaboah o namuk mimmennu harbeh, o miggag shel zeh lechatzer shel acher o lemaboy shello nishtattepu bo o leqarpep shel acher, veken miqqarpep shel zeh leqarpep shel acher. Vekol zeh bekelim sheshshabetu beechad mereshuyyot ellu. Abal kelim sheshshabetu babbayit vehotzian leachat mereshuyyot ellu, apillu behetter, kegon lechatzer meorebet shel bayit zeh, vaapillu hotziam bederek malbush — asur letaltelam lechatzer acheret o legag shel acher o leqarpep hammuqqap ledira shel acher (shehakkelim sheshshabetu babbayit — bekol maqom shehem dinam keillu hem babbayit, sheasur letaltelam mimmennu lemaqom acher shello erebu immo). Abal leqarpep shello huqqap ledira, apillu hu pachot mibbet satayim — en erub moil, sheapillu hu shello asur lehotzi letoko kelim sheshshabetu, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"ch. Veken kelim sheshshabetu beachat mereshuyyot ellu — asur lehaknisam lebayit acher shello ereb im reshut zo sheshshabat hakkeli betoko. Vaapillu hiknisam derek malbush lirshut sheereba im habbayit, kegon lechatzer meorebet shel bayit zeh — asur letaltelam mishsham labbayit, kevan sheshshabetu birshut sheenah meorebet im habbayit. (Vaapillu shabetu birshut hamorebet im habbayit, vehotziam mimmenna lirshut acheret sheenah meorebet im habbayit — asur lehaknisam meotah reshut labbayit o lehepek, im lo sheyyannichem techilla birshut hamorebet immo umishsham yaknisem labbayit, veken lehepek. Veken kelim sheshshabetu babbayit, vehotziam bederek malbush lirshut sheenah meorebet immo — asur letaltelam labbayit im lo yannichem techilla birshut hamorebet immo), veken lehepek:

Qarpep yoter mibbet satayim shello huqqap ledira — karmelit hu, veasur letaltel mimmennu leqarpep acher kamohu, lehaknis ulehotzi mizzeh lezeh, ki im b' ammot bezeh ub' ammot bezeh, kemo bishar b' karmelit, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"v:

Shette chatzerot sherotzot leareb yachad lehattir letaltel mizzo lezo ap kelim sheshshabetu babbattim, en tzerikin erub acher, ella haerub sheasu kebar kol achat leatzmah yolikennu echad mibbene hechatzer bishbil kullam veyittenennu beechad mibbatte sheniyya, vehu sheerebu bene chatzer hashsheniyya leatzman. Ubene chatzer hashsheniyya gam ken enan tzerikin pat acher kede leareb im zo, ella haerub sheasu kebar mattiran:

Veim yirtzeh yolik sham apillu pat mishshello, vekullam muttarim, hoil vehu kebar ereb im chaberayv — qoneh letzorek kullam. Vehu haddin im hu im chaberayv hem beinyan sheenan tzerikin leareb kelal benehem, kegon ab im banayv hamqabbelim peras mimmennu hashsheruyim lebaddam bechatzer achat, veken kol kayyotze bahem, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"a — hare echad mehem molik pat bishbil kullam, apillu mishshello, lechatzer hassemuka lahem leareb immah:

En b' chatzerot yekolim leareb yachad ella im ken yihyeh benehem petach rachab d' tepachim o challon sheyyesh bo d' al d', veyihyeh qetzato betok y' tepachim hannemukim laaretz, veaz im ratzu meorbim yachad, umuttarim letaltel apillu derek chorim usedaqim. Veim ratzu meorbin kol echad leatzmo, vaasurim letaltel mizzo lezo derek petachim vechallonot o chorim usedaqim o al gabbe hakkotel kelim sheshshabetu babbayit. Abal im kol hachallon hu lemala mi' tepachim — eno moil kelum, kevan sheyyesh tachtayv mechitztza gemura hacholeqet ben hechatzer, vei epshar lahen leareb yachad. Veim en berochbo d' tepachim, apillu hu arok harbeh — eno moil kelum. Veim hu agol — tzarik sheyyehe beheqqepo y"z tepachim pachot chomesh, kede shennukal lerabbea bo d' al d', shehaalakson shel merubba zeh shehu h' tepachim veg' chomashin hu rochab shel haiggul shehu shelish heqqepo, veg' peamim h' tepachim veg' chomashin hem y"z pachot chomesh, kazeh. Vetzarik sheyyehe mashshehu min merubba zeh tok y' tepachim laaretz:

Challon shebben b' battim sherotzim leareb yachad, kegon shello erebu hachatzerot zo im zo — yekolim leareb apillu hu gaboah lemala mi' tepachim, lepi shehabbayit, kevan shehu meqoreh, hare hu kemale, vahare zeh keillu en hachallon gaboah y' tepachim, kevan shehabbayit kullo memulla. Vehu haddin laarubba shebben bayit laaliyya, sheap al pi shehi lemala measara — im ratzu meorbin yachad, vaapillu en sham sullam laalot bo, ubilbad sheyyehe baarubba d' al d'. Veim asu seriga lipne hachallon — nitbattel mittorat challon, sheen hanneqabim mitztorpim led' tepachim, veken baarubba:
Bayit shebben shette chatzerot vehu patuach lishtehen, veereb im shettehen, abal hachatzerot lo erebu zo im zo — en letaltel kelim sheshshabetu babbattim mechatzer lechatzer al yede bayit zeh:

Haya ben b' chatzerot kotel gaboah y' tepachim al pene kol orko, o shehaya qarqaah shel achat mehachatzerot gaboah mechabero h' tepachim veasa alayv mechitztza h' tepachim lehashlimo laasara, vehu haddin kesheggaboah mechabero asara belo mechitztza — en yekolim leareb yachad. Veim haya hakkotel gaboah lishtehen asara, vehaya berosho perot — hare bene b' hachatzerot yekolim lehorid happerot lachatzerot, veken lehaalot alayv mipperot sheshshabetu bechatzer zo ulehoridam mimmennu lechatzer haacheret, ap al pi shello erebu zo im zo, ben sherosh hakkotel rachab d' tepachim ben sheeno rachab, shehare rosh hakkotel dino kegag, ushette hachatzerot kullan reshut achat hen lekelim sheshshabetu betokan ap al pi shello erebu. Abal perot sheshshabetu beachat mibbatte chatzer zo o zo — asur lehaalotam alayv o lehoridam mimmennu, mippene shehu reshut shel shettehen, vehen oserot zo al zo leinyan kelim sheshshabetu babbayit ad sheyyearebu. Vaapillu perot sheshshabetu alayv o bachatzerot — asur lehoridam mimmennu lehaknisam labbayit, sheim habbayit eno reshut achat ella im ken erebu. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehu rachab d' tepachim berosho. Abal im eno rachab d' tepachim — meqom petur hu ubatel lekan ulekan, veellu maalin alayv mikkan perot sheshshabetu babbayit veellu mikkan, veken ellu moridin mikkan perot sheshshabetu alayv umaknisim lebattehem veellu moridim mikkan umaknisim lebattehem. Abal perot sheheelu ellu mibbattehem vehinnichu berosho — asurim ellu lehorid lachatzeram, lepi sheal yede shenehem naaset kan leperot ellu sheshshabetu babbayit hotzaa lechatzer acheret shello ereba immo. Veap al pi shehunnechu bimqom petur benetayim, en zeh moil kelum, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"v sheyyesh lehachamir bezeh kedibre haoserim:

Veim haya hakkotel gaboah leachat mehachatzerot y' tepachim velashsheniyya eno gaboah asara, kegon sheqqarqaah shel achat mehen gaboah mishshel chabertah — mi sheenah gaboah lo asara muttar lehishtammesh bo ap bekelim sheshshabetu babbayit im ereba chatzer zo leatzmah, vehashsheni asur lehishtammesh bo ap bekelim sheshshabetu bechatzer, lepi shettashmish kotel zeh lemi sheggaboah lo asara hu tashmish beqoshi — notenim oto lezeh shettashmisho benachat, lepikak notenim kotel zeh lemi sheeno gaboah lo asara sheyyishtammesh bo ap bekelim sheshshabetu babbayit, umoneim anu et mi sheggaboah lo asara lehishtammesh bo ap bekelim sheshshabetu bechatzer, kede shello yeaser al zeh sheeno gaboah lo asara lehishtammesh bo bekelim sheshshabetu babbayit, lepi shekkotel zeh en dino kegag ella kechatzer, hoil veeno gaboah asara miqqarqait chatzer shel zeh, veim ken im gam hashsheni yihyeh lo reshut lehishtammesh bo ezeh tashmish — tehe reshut shenehem sholetet bekotel zeh, vihe asur lezeh lehotzi kelim sheshshabetu babbayit lachatzar shenehem. Vehu sheyyehe hakkotel rachab d'. Abal im eno rachab d' — meqom petur hu, umuttar lishnehem lehishtammesh bo ap min habbattim (apilv) [im] ereba kol chatzer leatzmah, ap al pi shello erebu beyachad:

Nipratz hakkotel shebbenehen ad eser ammot, vead biklal — hare hu kepetach, veim ratzu meorbin kol achat leatzmah. Vehu sheeno parutz bemilluo (ella nishtayyeru pas mashshehu mikkan umashshehu mikkan o pas d' tepachim mitztzad echad). Veim nipratz yoter meeser — chashubot shettehem kechatzer achat utzerikot leareb yachad. Vekol maqom mehakkotel sheeno gaboah y' tepachim, keparutz hu:

Kotel shebben b' chatzerot gaboah asara lishtehen, veheemid etzel hakkotel sullam rachab d' tepachim veken kenegdo bechatzer hashshenit, apillu en hassullamot mekuvvanim zeh keneged zeh ella meruchaqim zeh mikkeneged zeh pachot mig' tepachim — hare hem kimkuvvanim vachashubim kepetach lakkotel, veim ratzu meorbin shette hachatzerot yachad. Vaapillu im hem meruchaqim zeh mikkeneged zeh harbeh — im hakkotel rachab d' tepachim adayin chashubim hem kepetach, sheyyakol laalot besullam zeh velelek al hakkotel ad sullam hashsheni velered. Beezeh sullam ameru? Besullam sheyyesh bo d' shelibot, sheeno nittal beshabbat mechamat kobdo, ap al pi sheatid littelo achar hashshabbat. Abal pachot mikkan, hoil veqatan hu venoach littelo — kenatul hu, veeno chashub petach ella im ken zerootayv ushelibotayv gassot ukebedot. Veim en hakkotel gaboah ella asara, veheemid sullam gaboah shiba umashshehu verachab d' etzel hakkotel zaqup beyosher — kevan shello nishar shelosha ad rosh hakkotel, hare zeh kemaggia lerosho mammash umoil, ben leareb yachad, im heemid ken gam bechatzer hashshenit, uben lehattir lehishtammesh al hakkotel bekelim sheshshabetu babbayit lezeh sheheemid hassullam bachatzero. Veim bechatzer hashshenit en sham sullam lekotel zeh, sheaz naaseh kotel zeh — lezeh tashmisho benachat ulezeh tashmisho beqasheh, venotenim oto lezeh shettashmisho benachat:

Aqar chulya merosh hakkotel lemaato miggobah asara, im yesh meshek d' beorek mah shennitmaet (ap al pi sheen bo d' al d', kegon sheen beobi hakkotel d') — moil ben laasoto petach lekotel zeh leareb hachatzerot yachad im nitmaet ken kol obi hakkotel, uben lehishtammesh bekol hakkotel bikle habbayit im lo nitmaet bekol obyo ella mitztzad echad, venaaseh lezeh tashmisho benachat lemi shennitmaet mitztziddo, shennoach lo laalot bimqom hammiut umimmennu yaaleh al rosh kol hakkotel, ulehashsheni tashmisho beqasheh. Veim en bo d' — eno chashub kepetach leareb yachad, veken eno moil lehishtammesh bekol hakkotel bikle habbayit ella bemaqom shennitmaet bilbad, sheshsham hu tashmisho benachat lezeh shennitmaet mitztziddo, sheomed baqqarqa umishtammesh alayv benachat. Abal eno noach laalot derek alayv lerosh hakkotel, hoil veen bo d':

Bana itzteba lematta etzel hakkotel lemaato miggobah asara, sheen mimmenna lerosho y' tepachim, shennoach lo laalot bimqom hammiut umimmenna yaaleh al rosh kol hakkotel — im yesh bah d' al d', moelet lehishtammesh bekol hakkotel, shehare noach laalot derek aleha al rosh hakkotel, hoil veen mimmenna lerosho gobah asara. Abal enah chashuba kepetach lekotel zeh leareb yachad, apillu asa ken gam bechatzer hashsheniyya, hoil veyesh mimmenna lerosho g' tepachim. Veim en bah d' al d' — enah moelet apillu lehishtammesh al hakkotel kenegdah mammash, lepi sheen noach laamod aleha ulehishtammesh kesheen bah d' al d', veen zeh tashmish benachat:

Kapa sepel sheyyesh bo d' al d' vegaboah kol shehu, umiet bo gobah hakkotel measara, sheen mimmennu lerosho asara — moil lehishtammesh bekol hakkotel kemo itzteba, ap al pi sheatid littelo, ubilbad sheyyechabberennu betit laaretz chibbur shei epshar leshomto ad sheyyachpor baddeqer, sheaz i epshar lenotlo mishsham beshabbat. Abal im hattit munnach kak al ognayv hakkepuyim laaretz — muttar littelo beshabbat, shello naaset basis ledabar haasur, shehare en kavvanato sheyyehe hassepel meshammesh lehattit ella hattit meshammesh lehassepel lechabbero laaretz; vekol dabar hannittal beshabbat eno memaet, shekkenatul hu. Bana itzteba al itzteba, im yesh battachtona d' al d', o en bah d' veyesh baelyona d' al d', veen ben zo lezo g' tepachim — hare hen keitzteba achat sheyyesh bah d' al d' milmala, shemmoelet lehattir lehishtammesh bakkotel, abal lo laasot petach leareb yachad:

Ziz hayyotze min hakkotel bepachot mi' tepachim merosho veyesh bo d' al d', vesamak lo sullam kol shehu sheen berochbo d' — moil lehattir lo tashmish hakkotel, lepi shennoach lo laalot besullam velaamod al hazziz ulehishtammesh al hakkotel. Abal laasoto petach leareb yachad eno moil, ella im ken hazziz hu bepachot mig' tepachim lerosh hakkotel. Vehu shello tehe sheliba hattachtona gaboah min haaretz g' tepachim, velo yehe ben sheliba lishliba g' tepachim, sheaz naasa hazziz im kol hashshelibot hakkol echad, vahare yesh d' al d' milmala, ukeillu hi itzteba achat sheyyesh bah d' al d' milmala, shemmoelet lehattir tashmish hakkotel ap al pi sheqqetzara millematta. Vehu shessamak rosh hassullam bazziz mammash. Abal im semako bakkotel etzel hazziz — en sullam zeh madrega lazziz, velo naasu hakkol echad. Vekol zeman sheeno gaboah hakkotel k' tepachim — day lo beziz echad shemmannicho baemtza, shehare en gaboah asara ad hazziz, velo gaboah asara mimmennu ad rosh hakkotel. Veim hu gaboah k' — tzarik shene zizin, echad betok asara hattachtonim veechad betok asara haelyonim bepachot mi' tepachim lattachton, sheim haya hazziz gaboah asara mehaaretz veken im haelyon gaboah y' tepachim mehattachton — lo day lo besullam kol shehu sheen berochbo d'. Vehu shello yihyu hazzizin mekuvvanim zeh tachat zeh ella yihyu meshukim zeh mikkeneged zeh, kede sheyyehe rauy lehaamid sullam mizzeh lezeh, shehassullam sheyyaamid mehattachton lehaelyon yehe samuk baelyon mammash velo etzlo bakkotel:

Heemid b' sullamot zeh betzad zeh velo haya bemeshek shenehem rochab d', vehirchiqam zeh mizzeh kede sheyyehe bishnehem d', umille haavir shebbenehem beqash, sheasaan keen shelibot — eno moil lo lehattir tashmish bakkotel velo leareb yachad, lepi shemmeqom maamad haraglayim hu leolam beemtza hassullam, vekan en rauy laalot beqash. Veim heemid hassullam baemtza vehaqqash min hatztzad — moil, ben lehattir lo tashmish hakkotel ben leareb yachad, im maggia lepachot mig' tepachim lerosh hakkotel veasa ken gam bechatzer hashshenit, lepi shekkap haregel oleh besullam vehaqqash shemmin hatztzad rauy lehachaziq bo beyadayv velaalot:

En hassullam rachab d', uzeqapo bakkotel beyosher, vechaqaq etzlo bakkotel mikkan umikkan lehashlim rochbo led', kegon shehakkotel ab ubolet mitztzad hassullam — day lo (shichaziq) [sheyyachoq] begobah asara, shezzehu shiur gobah petach. Veap al pi shehakkotel gaboah harbeh, vesham en hassullam rachab d' — en bekak kelum, shehare yakol laalot lerosh hakkotel besullam ap al pi sheen berochbo d'. Abal im lo heemid sullam kelal, ella chaqaq bakkotel kemin shelibot laalot bahem — tzarik sheyyachoq berochab d' bekol gobah hakkotel, veaz moil ben lehattir tashmish ben leareb yachad im asa ken gam bechatzer hashshenit:

Haya ilan betzad hakkotel veasahu sullam lakkotel — moil leareb yachad. Abal im asa meatze ashera sullam lakkotel — enah moelet, mippene sheasur laalot aleha min hattora, shehare asura bahanaa. Mah sheen ken shear ilan, sheen issur laalot bo beshabbat ella middibre soperim, ubeben hashshemashot shehu sheat qeniyyat haerub lo gazeru al shebut shel dibrehem letzorek mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besimman rs"a, veerube chatzerot hu gam ken debar mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"v:

Charitz shebben shette chatzerot, amoq asara verachab d' — en yekolim leareb yachad apillu hu male qash veteben, kol zeman shello bittelam sham (lepi shehu dabar hannittal beshabbat, vekol dabar hannittal beshabbat eno memaet miggobah asara. Abal im nitmaet measara bedabar sheeno nittal beshabbat, ap al pi shello bittelo sham veomed lepannoto achar hashshabbat — moil laasot petach leareb yachad im yirtzu, kemo shennitbaer lemala besullamot vesepel kapuy, abal eno moil lebattel mechitztzot hecharitz legamre, sheyyihyu tzerikim leareb yachad, ella im ratzu meorbim kol achat leatzmah. Veken haddin apillu bedabar hannittal beshabbat ella shebbittelo beperush leshabbat zo, shello yittelennu mikkan ad lemotzae shabbat, sheapillu bittel leshabbat achat bilbad — moil laasot petach). Veim nitmaet measara beapar utzerorot shennapelu bo, apillu bistam, shello bittelam sham — tzerikim leareb yachad, shessetam apar utzerorot shebbecharitz mebuttalin hen, venitbattelu mechitztzotayv. Abal im atid lepannotam mimmennu leachar zeman, ap al pi shebbittelam leezeh zeman — enam mebattelim mechitztzot hecharitz, vikolim leareb kol achat bipne atzmah (veap sheyyesh omerim sheapillu bittul leshabbat achat moil lebattel mechitztza, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"ch, mikkol maqom bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel, veyesh lismok al dibre haomerim sheen mechitztza mitbattelet ella bedabar shemmebattelo sham leolam, kemo shennitbaer sham):

Natan alayv neser kemin gesher missepat hecharitz el sepato lerochbo, im hanneser hu rachab d' — chashub kepetach, vikolim leareb yachad im yirtzu. Vehu haddin im milleo kemin gesher rachab d' bedabar hambattelo sham (apillu leshabbat achat o bedabar sheeno nittal beshabbat). Veim natan hanneser leorek hecharitz, apillu en bo ella kol shehu — chashub kepetach shehare miet rochab hecharitz mid', vehu sheyyehe beorek neser zeh d', kede sheyyehe rochab happetach d'. Veim yesh beorko yoter meeser ammot — enan yekolim leareb kol achat bipne atzmah ella tzerikot leareb yachad, shehare hen petuchot zo lezo beyoter meeser, kevan sheen berochab hecharitz d' bikshiur orko shel neser zeh (vehu sheen dato littol hanneser mikkan leachar zeman, shekkol sheeno mebattelo kan leolam eno mebattel mechitztza lehachamir):
Im hecharitz amoq leechad asara velashsheni eno amoq asara, o shehu shaveh lishtehen —dino kekotel:

Gadish shel teben shebben b' chatzerot sheen benehen mechitztza, im hu gaboah asara bekol meshek orek hachatzerot shemmapsiq benehen — enan yekolim leareb yachad, ella kol achat mearebet leatzmah. Nitmaet measara bechol — tzerikot leareb yachad, veim ereba[h] kol achat leatzmah, oserot zo al zo, kevan sheen benehen mechitztza gaboah asara velo erebu zo im zo. Veim nitmaet beshabbat enan oserot, sheshshabbat kevan shehuttera — huttera, ukemo sheyyitbaer besimman sha"d. Ubeod shello nitmaet, veken im nitmaet beshabbat velo mibbeod yom — asur leshum echad mehem litten min hatteben letok quppato lehaakil libhemto, mippene shehatteben shellematta measara huqtza meetmol limchitztza, shehare ereba kol achat leatzmah al semak shehaggadish hu mechitztza benehem, umetaltelin bechatzer al semak zeh (im ken hissichu datan mimmennu legamre millehistappeq bo beshabbat) ukeillu hiqtzahu beyadayim. Veap shennimleku achar kak — eno moil kelum (shemmittok shehuqtza ben hashshemashot, huqtza lekol hashshabbat) (veod, shekkevan shessameku alayv limchitztza lehattir tiltul, yesh issur bistirato middibre soperim, kemo shennitbaer besimman sht"v. Umittok shehuqtza ben hashshemashot mechamat issur setira, huqtza lekol hashshabbat), veasur littelo beyadayim. Vegazeru gam al mah shellemala measara, shemma yehe nittal veholek ad lematta measara. Vaapillu lehaamid sham habbehema shettokal meatzmah asur, kemo sheasur lehaamidah al kol muqtzeh, mishshum gezera shemma yittol beyadayv veyaakilenna. Abal yakol laamod bepaneha kede shello yehe lah derek lintot ella derek sham vetokal meatzmah, kemo shennitbaer besimman shk"d. Bammeh debarim amurim? Begadish shebben b' chatzerot. Abal begadish shebben b' battim, kegon bayit shebben b' chatzerot ushettehen petuchot lo veyesh gadish shel teben beemtzaitan, vecholeqot lishnayim vekol chatzer mishtammeshet bachatzi bayit happatuach lah, veap al pi shehachatzerot lo erebu yachad — enan oserot zo al zo babbayit shebbenehen, lepi shehaggadish hu mechitztza benehen, veap al pi ken muttarim littol ulehaakil libhemtam beyadayim ellu mikkan veellu mikkan min hatteben (hassamuk lattiqra) (shellemala measara), veen chosheshin shemma yihyu notelin veholekin ad (lematta mi') (sheyyipchot mig' tepachim), lepi shekkevan shehaggadish hu bebayit sheyyesh lo tiqra, nikkar haddabar harbeh keshehu nipchat veholek. Veyesh omerim shebbintilat hatteben en bo mishshum muqtzeh velo mishshum setirat mechitztza, hoil velo naasa mittechilla leshem mechitztza, ella mah sheaseru littol miggadish shebben b' chatzerot hu mishshum shemma yittol veyelek ad sheyyitmaet measara vetitbattel hammechitztza vitaltelu bechatzer kemittechilla. Veen hachashash shemma yippachet measara beshabbat, shehare shabbat kevan shehuttera — huttera, ella aseru littol mimmennu bequppa leolam, ben beshabbat ben bechol, mishshum shemma yippachet measara beereb shabbat samuk leben hashshemashot velo yargish baddabar vitaltelu beshabbat beissur, ella yesalleqennu kullo bebat achat. Velaken aseru gam ken lehaamid habbehema sham ap al pi shebbaakilat habbehema en lachush lezeh, sheen darkah leekol harbeh kol kak bepaam achat ad sheyyitmaet measara, mikkol maqom gazeru shemma yaakil bequppa.
